name: Chalice of the Pact
body:
Aura moderate conjuration; CL 9th; Slot —; Price 16,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

Each of these chalices appears drastically different depending on the pact of the invoker who forged it. Regardless, if an invoker with the appropriate pact drinks from this chalice she increases her effective invoker level by 4 for the purposes of her pact and mystic blast class features and gains one taboo which lasts for 24 hours. However if she fails to drink from the chalice on the next day she must pay 4 points from her Charisma score.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Special appropriate pact class feature, creator must be an invoker; Cost 8,000 gp
